description: The plot illustrates the results of "Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny," comparing the performance of five different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6 with a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 30 to 70 at intervals of 10. All data series are plotted in gray. The line representing "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" is a solid line with circle markers; it begins at an epoch of 0 with a WER of approximately 68.8 and steadily declines across the x-axis to end at an epoch of 6 with a WER of roughly 36.2. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" configuration is shown as a solid line with square markers, starting at x=0 with a value near 59.8, dropping to 51.2 at x=1, and continuing to decline to approximately 32.2 at x=6. The "tiny int4" line is a dashed line with circle markers that shares a starting point of 68.8 at x=0, decreases to 39.5 at x=4, remains steady to 39.4 at x=5, and ends with a slight increase to 40.1 at x=6. The "tiny int8" line is a dashed line with square markers, beginning at x=0 with a WER of approximately 59.8, dropping to 46.7 at x=1, and following a gradual downward trend to finish at roughly 37.0 at x=6. Finally, the "tiny" configuration is depicted by a dotted line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it maintains the lowest WER throughout the plot, starting at approximately 28.9 at x=0, experiencing a slight drop to 24.2 at x=3, and ending at roughly 23.0 at x=6.
